instructions.target: I can check whether an answer key is right instead of trusting it.
instructions.question: Does `reply` show the work `target` describes, given `task`?

criteria.true: the reply gives specific, checkable evidence of the work this target describes: it names the files, commands or output, or shows the content. Neither holds when the evidence would sit only in an item `reply` names as one Jev cannot see or open
criteria.false: the reply only asserts this work in general terms, or does not show it. Neither holds when the evidence would sit only in an item `reply` names as one Jev cannot see or open
